description: Upload an image once (url=, or POST the bytes) and get an image_id for /image-edit. Every edit is re-rendered from this original, so quality never drifts. Returns size, format, colors, metadata, GPS warning, and a clean copy link. The upload is kept 7 days after you last use it. FREE TIER: add free=1. Price: $0.002 USDC on Base per successful call (x402).

data_base64.description: The image itself, base64-encoded (use instead of url for a local image)

free.description: Set to 1 to use the free tier: no payment, lower limits (10 MB, 30 calls/hour, 24h links)

url.description: Public URL of the image (or POST the image instead)

name: image_upload
title: Image upload for lossless editing
